name: Harming Your Body
overview: Scripture instructs believers to honor their bodies as the Lord's creation, forbidding physical markings such as cutting or tattoos as stated in Leviticus 19:28. While the flesh is weak and prone to temptation (Matthew 26:41), God offers healing and restoration for those who seek Him earnestly (Psalms 30:2; Joel 2:25). Trusting fully in the Lord rather than our own understanding (Proverbs 3:5) guides us to respect the body God has given and avoid harm that dishonors Him.
